# IItemPickups.RespawnTime property

How long a pickup stays taken before it comes back: 5 seconds by default. Each game counts its own copy of a pickup from when it learns of the take, so this applies on the games that set it.

```csharp
public TimeSpan RespawnTime { get; set; }
```
